sources.note: 66 numbered 001/066-066/066, 8 physically unnumbered energy kinds (74 distinct master slots)

sources.description: 한국어 인쇄 카드 025/066 하느라기: 반짝이는 별이 보이는 짙은 보라·남색 밤하늘과 수평선 아래쪽 주황·노랑 황혼빛이 공존. 색 대비가 강한 일러스트.

notableFindings.finding: 8 basic energy master slot codes 067/066-074/066 are indexing constructs; Korean checklist shows no physical printed card number.
notableFindings.resolution: Persist physical number as null without changing canonical identity.

notableFindings.finding: The Korean numbered list contains two separate ネ모 cards and two 박사의 연구 cards; repeated names do not mean duplicate canonical identities.
notableFindings.resolution: Preserve both separate card numbers and hold distinct artwork variants.

limitations: Only exact Korean card 025/066 artwork was inspected via a Korean physical-card product photo. The other 73 Korean artwork images have not been visually verified; no claim of full thematic completion. No self-hosted image binary upload or deployment performed.
